原方程变为 $y'+\frac{2x}{x^2+1}y=\frac{4x^2}{x^2+1}$

所求通解为

$y=e^{-\int\frac{2x}{x^2+1}dx}\left(c+\int\frac{4x^2}{x^2+1}e^{\int\frac{2x}{x^2+1}dx}dx\right)$

$=e^{-\ln(x^2+1)}\left(c+\int\frac{4x^2}{x^2+1}e^{\ln(x^2+1)}dx\right)=\frac{1}{x^2+1}(\frac{4}{3}x^3+c)$

微分方程 $(x^2+1)y\prime+2xy=4x^2$ 的解为（ ） $y=\frac1{x^2+1}(\frac43x^3+cx^2)$ $y=\frac c{x^2+1}(\frac43x^3+1)$ $y=\frac1{x^2+1}(\frac43x^3+c)$ $y=\frac c{x^2+1}(\frac43x^3-x)$ 原方程变为 $y'+\frac{2x}{x^2+1}y=\frac{4x^2}{x^2+1}$

所求通解为

$y=e^{-\int\frac{2x}{x^2+1}dx}\left(c+\int\frac{4x^2}{x^2+1}e^{\int\frac{2x}{x^2+1}dx}dx\right)$

$=e^{-\ln(x^2+1)}\left(c+\int\frac{4x^2}{x^2+1}e^{\ln(x^2+1)}dx\right)=\frac{1}{x^2+1}(\frac{4}{3}x^3+c)$
